The '''1945 National Division''' was the eighth edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] won their fourth title.

==Participants==

*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[Beykoz S.K.D.|Beykoz 1908]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*Uçaksavar - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*[[Ankara Demirspor]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 3rd
*[[Altınordu F.K.|Altınordu]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[Karşıyaka S.K.|Karşıyaka]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
